office_does: The coroner investigates sudden, violent, suspicious and unexplained deaths in Stevens County and determines cause and manner of death.
race_blurb: Open seat: Coroner Ramona Colvin is not running. Chief Deputy Coroner Johnathan Waldrop runs on continuity with the office's recent accreditation and grants; Spokane County death investigator Roseanne Ennis Jezerinac runs on prevention, transparency and more autopsy funding. Both prefer the Republican Party; Waldrop led the primary 73% to 26%.

candidates.summary: Stevens County chief deputy coroner with 14 years in medical examiner and coroner work, running to build on the office's recent changes.
highlights: Chief deputy coroner; never held public office [S1]
Credits the office with national accreditation, federal grants and repaired agency partnerships [S1][S2]
Says the office kept a balanced budget while minimizing taxpayer funds [S1]
Wants to expand its education program and recruit people into the field [S2]

experience.basis: Current chief deputy running on continuity with the office's direction, though he has never held elected office.

spending.basis: Cites a balanced budget kept while minimizing the use of taxpayer funds.

safety.basis: Describes a community education initiative aimed at preventing avoidable deaths, a secondary theme of his campaign.

candidates.summary: Spokane County medical examiner's death investigator and former Stevens deputy coroner, running on prevention, education and transparency.
highlights: Says she has investigated more than 1,600 deaths; board-certified death investigator [S1][S2]
Would put prevention and education 'to the forefront': overdoses, suicide, mental health, missing and murdered Indigenous people [S1][S2]
Promises more transparency and more of the current budget for autopsies [S1]

safety.basis: Platform centers on prevention and public-health education (overdose, suicide, mental health) drawn from death investigations.

experience.basis: Experienced investigator from outside the current office leadership promising changes in transparency and budget priorities.
